description: §66.3 rule 8: `<a=(@b + 1)/>` / `<b=(@a + 1)/>` are both cyclic and unannotated — the cycle diagnostic E-DERIVED-CIRCULAR-DEP wins and E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE is not reported.
rationale: §66.3 rule 8: "When an unannotated own value's initializer reaches that own value again through other own values, the cycle's diagnostic is reported and `E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE` is not: for derived values (§66.9 rule 3) that is `E-DERIVED-CIRCULAR-DEP` (§6.6.10)". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §8 ruling 6).
